title: Meituan open-sources 1.6T-parameter LongCat-2.0 trained on Chinese chips
summary: Meituan released LongCat-2.0 under an MIT licence with a 1M-token context, reportedly trained on domestic ASICs; it had topped OpenRouter rankings anonymously as 'Owl Alpha'.
reason: Mid-size open release; also signals Chinese compute self-sufficiency.

title: EU Council gives final approval to AI Act delay
summary: The Council of the EU formally approved the AI omnibus, locking in the postponement of high-risk obligations before the Aug 2, 2026 deadline; publication in the Official Journal was expected in July.
reason: Final step of the same rollback; development of Jun 16 vote.

title: Meta's Brain2Qwerty v2 decodes brain activity to text non-invasively
summary: Meta said its MEG-based system decodes typed sentences from brain signals with about 61% word accuracy.
